notes.title: Another Big Update: Cursed Mansion is now Available in Korean Language!
notes.notes:
Hi Kind Spirit,

We are thrilled to share spine-tingling news with all of you dear kind spirits!! The haunted Cursed Mansion is spreading its terror as we release a new Korea language versions on the Steam platform on 27 October 2023.

For our fearless Korean players, you can now unravel the sinister mysteries of Cursed Mansion with the game fully translated into Korean, ensuring an immersive and eerie experience.

notes.title: Full Release Announcement [30 March 2023]
notes.notes:
Hi Kinder Spirits!

Finally the time is come! the final build is finished and we are thrilled to finally confirm our Full Release on March 30, 2023. Are you ready for the full experience of the CURSED MANSION ???

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33816142/e0fc18d8a7c65d668882416ae8036d6aa448ec6c.jpg


The purchase link will be available during the 30 March 2023, the English game will be released globally at the same time. If you already purchase the Early access version, you can update the game to the full version during the 30 March 2023. 

See you in the mansions, Kinder spirits!

notes.title: December 2020 Update
notes.notes:
We're now at December and 2021 is almost half a month away.

To prepare for our release, we will be doing an open beta test around next week until the end of the year.

If you are interested, you can register on this form: https://forms.gle/2dtq88Bnk9zfQPjz5
You can also ask the others to join in, don't forget to tell them to put your identification in the form, there might be a surprise later on.

We will inform you through email when our game is ready.

Thank you for taking interest in our game, see you in the next update!

notes.notes:

We've updated a lot! From the graphics to the stories. The sounds are also amazing, so use your headphone for immersion.

For feedback and bug report, or maybe you just want to talk to the dev, join our Discord https://discord.gg/E9rJQeT
